Asset: MILOSHOPHAND native colour-specific six-view product atlas, ML Double Hem Basic Tee, Đen #151515, quarter 0.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve exactly all six upright source poses, camera angles, garment cut, seams, collar, sleeves, pockets, closures, folds, scale, cell layout and ivory studio background.
Use the source as the construction reference. Preserve its existing contrasting trim assignment and all hardware; finish the main fabric in the requested target colour.
Change only fabric colour styling to Đen #151515; realistic dyed Cotton, even natural shadows, clean colour edges. No colour-filter overlay, blotches, halos, extra graphics or merged marks. Keep structural contrast panels and pocket construction exactly as the sources and anchor, no swapped material roles.
Retain the layered DOUBLE HEM construction with a narrow contrasting underlayer visible below hem and at sleeve ends, plus contrast collar. Preserve chest ML and floral rear MiloShopHand artwork; ink ivory on black or charcoal on white.
Branding: preserve the source graphic shapes, placement and exact text "MiloShopHand" only where visible on the source back. One intact chest ML only where that chest is visible. Ink soft ivory as on anchor. Keep graphics occluded correctly at side angles; no duplicated front marks, no new sleeve art.
Output EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal square cells, native 1536x1024. Full garment with margins in each cell, no cropping. Row-major nominal views: 0,15,30,45,60,75 degrees, FRONT towards LEFT-facing profile; front points LEFT.
No labels, captions, borders, grid lines, people, hanger or mannequin. Commercial product photography, maintain this specific garment's identity.
